what: Payouts are created twice monthly on the 1st and 15th of the month and include all sales since the last payout. Net sales are held for 13 days before becoming available for payout on the 14th and 28th of the month. Payouts can take 1-5 days to appear in a bank account.
verbatim_snippet: "Payouts are created twice monthly on the 1st and 15th of the month and include all sales since the last payout. Net sales are held for 13 days before becoming available for payout on the 14th and 28th of the month. Payouts can take 1-5 days to appear in your bank account. For example, if you make a sale on the 4th of the month, it will be included in the payout created on the 15th, and paid out on the 28th."
